_comment: Tier-2 for febio::plasticity#0. H/E swept over three decades on the shipped uniaxial deck: every value runs to normal termination with exit 0 and no diagnostic, and the peak |sz| rises monotonically with H by more than a factor of two from the lowest ratio to the highest. That monotone rise is what makes "a peak stress well above Y is the correct answer, not a missed yield" checkable. The fixture computes the peaks; no number is carried in the catalogue text. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'hardening_sweep=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
